# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ACTIVATION: this file ships as .txt because the Arena bot token
# cannot create files under .github/workflows/. To turn on real-Chrome
# Lighthouse verification (score gates + page screenshots) AND the
# community-pages freshness gate, run:
#
#   mkdir -p .github/workflows
#   mv .github/landing-verify.yml.txt .github/workflows/landing-verify.yml
#   git add .github && git commit -m "ci: landing lighthouse" && git push
#
# (or grant the Arena GitHub app Workflows: read+write)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
name: Landing page verify (SEO + motion + Lighthouse)

on:
  push:
    branches: ['arena/**']
    paths: ['app/web/**', 'app/scripts/export-web.js', 'app/scripts/build-communities.mjs', 'app/scripts/verify-site.mjs', 'app/scripts/lighthouse-ci.mjs', 'app/src/push/links.js', 'app/src/push/routing.js', '.github/workflows/landing-verify.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: app/package-lock.json

      - name: Generated pages freshness (community-niches.json ⇄ web output)
        working-directory: app
        run: node scripts/build-communities.mjs --check

      - name: Build the site (same command Vercel runs)
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
          CI=true node scripts/export-web.js

      - name: SEO / structured-data checks (view-source level)
        working-directory: app
        run: node scripts/verify-site.mjs

      - name: Motion runtime checks (jsdom)
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          node scripts/test-site-motion.mjs index.html
          node scripts/test-site-motion.mjs chat.html

      - name: Real-browser checks — Lighthouse, tokens, screenshots
        working-directory: app
        env:
          PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD: '1'
        run: |
          npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund lighthouse@12 puppeteer@23
          node scripts/lighthouse-ci.mjs

      - name: Upload page screenshots + Lighthouse reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: landing-verification
          path: app/lighthouse-artifacts/
          if-no-files-found: warn
